title: PI objectives — tranche 7 (retrospective, 2026-11-28)
body:
# PI objectives — tranche 7

## Objectives

- O1 — S16's inference ledger and prompt audit are accepted: every model call is a durable, tenant-scoped row carrying the prompt's identity, the token counts and both prompt-cache classes.
- O2 — S06c's MCP tasks surface is accepted: one task-capable action drives a project as a task and a client polls, answers and reads a terminal result with no Python service and no new table.
- O3 — S15's capability aggregate is accepted and the project stays active: a run resolves its capability and executor, readiness is reported before the run starts, a cited passage comes from a pinned `strata` pack, and memory is written, consolidated and recalled by `source_id`.
- O4 — The tranche-7 exit gate exits 0 on three fresh receipts and hands a green tranche to the review that #755 records.

## Business value

O1 9, O2 8, O3 10, O4 8 (committed: O1–O3; O4 is the exit and carries no product value of its own, only the gate the next tranche waits on).

## Measurement

O1 by `acceptance/programme/S16.toml` and the S16 receipt, whose gate names the three tables, the engine seam and the audit procedure. O2 by `acceptance/programme/S06c.toml` and the S06c receipt, whose gate is the task round trip through `projects.execute`. O3 by `acceptance/programme/S15.toml` and the S15 receipt, whose gate is the capability resolution and the strata round trip. O4 by `scripts/check-tranche-exit.py --tranche 7`, which is green only when all three receipts are green and fresh at one head sha.

## Evidence

The PI plan `PI plan — tranche 7 (retrospective, 2026-11-28)`, programme `01a1d039-0d24-7d16-ae52-4841e96ccfac`, tranche `01a1e9e1-0fab-7068-99f2-a233045b1276`, and the refinement record `docs/evidence/rework/tranche-7/refinement-wsjf.json`. The receipts it is judged against are `docs/evidence/rework/{S16,S06c,S15}.json`, each read at the snapshot the plan pinned.
